column2:
name(n./v.)名字、命名、說出名字
nameless(adj.)無名的
namely(adv.)也就是
first name 名字
name after 以……命名
What is your name, please?
(請問你叫什麼名字？)
They named their baby after his grandfather.
(他們以寶寶的祖父為他命名。)

national(adj.)國家的、全國的
nation(n.)國家、民族
nationality(n.)國籍
national park 國家公園
national holiday 國定假日
We visited a national park last summer.
(我們去年夏天參觀了一座國家公園。)
Double Ten Day is a national holiday in Taiwan.
(雙十節是臺灣的國定假日。)

nature(n.)自然、大自然、本性
natural(adj.)自然的、天生的
naturally(adv.)自然地、當然
human nature 人性
in nature 本質上、在自然界
I love to walk in nature on weekends.
(我喜歡在週末到大自然中散步。)
It is human nature to want to be loved.
(渴望被愛是人的天性。)

near(prep./adj./adv./v.)在……附近、近的、接近
nearly(adv.)幾乎
nearby(adj./adv.)附近的、在附近
near future 不久的將來
near here 在這附近
Is there a bank near here?
(這附近有銀行嗎？)
My school is very near my home.
(我的學校離我家很近。)

neck(n.)脖子、頸部
(無詞性變化)
long neck 長脖子
neck and neck 不分上下
The giraffe has a very long neck.
(長頸鹿有很長的脖子。)
She wore a red scarf around her neck.
(她在脖子上圍了一條紅色圍巾。)

need(v./n./aux.)需要、必須、需求
needy(adj.)貧困的
needless(adj.)不必要的
in need 在困難中、有需要
need help 需要幫忙
I need some water after running.
(跑步之後我需要喝點水。)
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
(患難見真情。)

net(n./v.)網子、網路、用網捕
network(n.)網路、網絡
fishing net 漁網
safety net 安全網、保障
The fisherman threw his net into the sea.
(漁夫把他的網子撒進海裡。)
The ball hit the net and fell down.
(球打到網子後掉了下來。)

never(adv.)從不、絕不
(無詞性變化)
never mind 沒關係、不要緊
never again 再也不
I have never been to Japan.
(我從來沒去過日本。)
Never give up on your dreams.
(絕對不要放棄你的夢想。)

new(adj.)新的、陌生的
newly(adv.)新近地、最近
brand new 全新的
new year 新年
I just bought a brand new bike.
(我剛買了一台全新的腳踏車。)
He is new to this school.
(他是這所學校的新生。)

news(n.)新聞、消息
(無詞性變化)
good news 好消息
breaking news 即時新聞、突發新聞
I have some good news for you.
(我有一個好消息要告訴你。)
My dad watches the news every night.
(我爸爸每天晚上都看新聞。)

newspaper(n.)報紙、報社
(無詞性變化)
daily newspaper 日報
read the newspaper 看報紙
My grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.
(我爺爺每天早上都看報紙。)
Her photo was in the newspaper today.
(她的照片今天登上了報紙。)

next(adj./adv.)下一個的、其次、接著
(無詞性變化)
next to 在……旁邊
next time 下一次
See you next week!
(下週見！)
The bookstore is next to the bakery.
(書店就在麵包店旁邊。)

nice(adj.)好的、令人愉快的、親切的
nicely(adv.)好好地、和善地
nice to meet you 很高興認識你
nice weather 好天氣
It is nice to meet you.
(很高興認識你。)
Our new teacher is very nice to us.
(我們的新老師對我們很親切。)

night(n.)夜晚、晚上
nightly(adj./adv.)每夜的、每晚
at night 在晚上
last night 昨晚
I did my homework late last night.
(我昨晚很晚才寫功課。)
Owls usually hunt at night.
(貓頭鷹通常在晚上獵食。)

no(adj./adv./n.)沒有的、不、拒絕
nope(adv.)不(口語)
no longer 不再
no way 不可能、沒門
There is no milk in the fridge.
(冰箱裡沒有牛奶了。)
Nope, I don't want to go out tonight.
(不要，我今晚不想出去。)

nobody(pron./n.)沒有人、無名小卒
(無詞性變化)
nobody else 沒有其他人
nobody knows 沒人知道
Nobody was at home when I called.
(我打電話時沒有人在家。)
Nobody knows the answer to this question.
(沒有人知道這個問題的答案。)

noise(n.)噪音、聲響
noisy(adj.)吵鬧的
noiseless(adj.)無聲的
make noise 製造噪音
loud noise 很大的聲響
Please don't make any noise in the library.
(請不要在圖書館製造噪音。)
A loud noise woke me up last night.
(昨晚一聲巨響把我吵醒了。)

noisy(adj.)吵鬧的、喧鬧的
noise(n.)噪音
noisily(adv.)吵鬧地
noisy street 吵雜的街道
noisy neighbors 吵鬧的鄰居
The classroom was very noisy before class.
(上課前教室非常吵鬧。)
I can't sleep because of my noisy neighbors.
(因為鄰居很吵，我睡不著。)

noon(n.)中午、正午
(無詞性變化)
at noon 在中午
high noon 正午
We usually eat lunch at noon.
(我們通常在中午吃午餐。)
The store closes at noon on Sundays.
(這家店星期天中午就打烊。)

north(n./adj./adv.)北方、北方的、向北
northern(adj.)北方的、北部的
northward(adv.)向北
North Pole 北極
the north of 在……的北部
Taipei is in the north of Taiwan.
(臺北位於臺灣北部。)
The birds fly north in spring.
(這些鳥在春天往北飛。)

nose(n.)鼻子
nosy(adj.)愛管閒事的
runny nose 流鼻水
blow your nose 擤鼻涕
I have a cold and a runny nose.
(我感冒了，還流鼻水。)
The dog has a very good nose.
(這隻狗的嗅覺非常靈敏。)

not(adv.)不、沒有
(無詞性變化)
not at all 一點也不、不客氣
not only... but also 不但……而且
I am not hungry right now.
(我現在不餓。)
Thank you. Not at all.
(謝謝你。不客氣。)

note(n./v.)筆記、便條、注意、記下
notebook(n.)筆記本
noted(adj.)著名的
take notes 做筆記
leave a note 留張便條
Please take notes during the class.
(上課時請做筆記。)
Mom left a note on the table for me.
(媽媽在桌上留了張紙條給我。)

nothing(pron./n.)沒有東西、沒什麼
(無詞性變化)
nothing but 只有、只不過
for nothing 免費、白白地
There is nothing in the box.
(箱子裡什麼都沒有。)
I have nothing to do this afternoon.
(我今天下午沒什麼事可做。)

notice(v./n.)注意到、察覺、通知、公告
noticeable(adj.)顯而易見的
notice board 布告欄
without notice 未事先通知
Did you notice her new haircut?
(你有注意到她的新髮型嗎？)
Please read the notice on the board.
(請閱讀布告欄上的公告。)

now(adv./n.)現在、目前
(無詞性變化)
right now 立刻、現在
from now on 從現在開始
I am busy right now.
(我現在很忙。)
From now on, I will get up early.
(從現在起，我會早起。)

number(n./v.)數字、號碼、數量、編號
numerous(adj.)許多的
a number of 許多的
phone number 電話號碼
Can I have your phone number?
(可以給我你的電話號碼嗎？)
A number of students joined the club.
(許多學生加入了這個社團。)

nurse(n./v.)護理師、看護、照顧
nursing(n.)護理
nursery(n.)托兒所、育嬰室
school nurse 學校護理師
nurse back to health 照顧使恢復健康
My aunt works as a nurse in a hospital.
(我阿姨在醫院當護理師。)
She nursed the sick bird back to health.
(她細心照顧那隻生病的鳥直到牠康復。)

O.K.(adj./adv./n./v.)好、沒問題、同意、批准
OK(adj./adv./n./v.)好、沒問題(同 O.K.)
okay(adj./adv./n./v.)好、沒問題(同 O.K.)
feel O.K. 感覺還好
get the O.K. 獲得同意
Are you O.K.? You look tired.
(你還好嗎？你看起來很累。)
Is it okay if I sit here?
(我可以坐在這裡嗎？)

o’clock(adv.)……點鐘
(無詞性變化)
at seven o’clock 在七點鐘
one o’clock 一點鐘
I get up at six o’clock every day.
(我每天六點鐘起床。)
The movie starts at eight o’clock.
(電影八點鐘開始。)

of(prep.)……的、屬於、由……組成
(無詞性變化)
a cup of 一杯
because of 因為
I'd like a cup of tea, please.
(請給我一杯茶。)
She is one of my best friends.
(她是我最好的朋友之一。)

off(adv./prep./adj.)離開、脫離、關掉、休假的
(無詞性變化)
turn off 關掉
day off 休假日
Please turn off the lights.
(請把燈關掉。)
I have a day off tomorrow.
(我明天放假。)

office(n.)辦公室、職位
officer(n.)官員、警官
official(adj./n.)官方的、官員
post office 郵局
office hours 辦公時間
My father works in an office downtown.
(我爸爸在市中心的辦公室上班。)
I need to send a letter at the post office.
(我需要到郵局寄一封信。)

officer(n.)警官、官員、軍官
office(n.)辦公室
official(adj./n.)官方的、官員
police officer 警察
army officer 陸軍軍官
The police officer helped the lost child.
(警察幫助了那個走失的孩子。)
He wants to be an army officer someday.
(他希望有一天成為陸軍軍官。)

often(adv.)常常、經常
(無詞性變化)
how often 多久一次
very often 非常頻繁
How often do you play basketball?
(你多久打一次籃球？)
I often walk my dog after dinner.
(我常常在晚餐後遛狗。)

oil(n./v.)油、石油、上油
oily(adj.)油膩的
olive oil 橄欖油
cooking oil 食用油
Mom cooks vegetables with olive oil.
(媽媽用橄欖油炒青菜。)
The price of oil went up again.
(油價又上漲了。)

old(adj.)老的、舊的、……歲的
(無詞性變化)
old friend 老朋友
years old ……歲
My brother is ten years old.
(我弟弟十歲。)
I met an old friend at the station.
(我在車站遇到一位老朋友。)

on(prep./adv.)在……上面、在(某日)、開著
(無詞性變化)
on time 準時
turn on 打開(電器)
The book is on the desk.
(書在書桌上。)
Please turn on the TV.
(請把電視打開。)

once(adv./conj./n.)一次、曾經、一旦
(無詞性變化)
at once 立刻
once a week 一週一次
I go swimming once a week.
(我一週去游泳一次。)
Once you start, you can't stop.
(一旦你開始了，就停不下來。)

online(adj.)線上的、網路上的
(無詞性變化)
online shopping 網路購物
online game 線上遊戲
Online shopping is very popular now.
(網路購物現在非常流行。)
He plays online games with his friends.
(他和朋友一起玩線上遊戲。)

only(adv./adj./conj.)只、唯一的、可是
(無詞性變化)
only child 獨生子女
not only 不僅
She is an only child.
(她是獨生女。)
I only have ten dollars.
(我只有十元。)

open(adj./v.)開著的、打開、開放
opening(n.)開幕、空缺
openly(adv.)公開地
open the door 開門
open-minded 心胸開闊的
Could you open the window, please?
(可以請你打開窗戶嗎？)
The museum is open on Sundays.
(博物館星期天有開放。)

or(conj.)或者、否則
(無詞性變化)
or else 否則
sooner or later 遲早
Do you want tea or coffee?
(你要茶還是咖啡？)
Hurry up, or you will be late.
(快一點，否則你會遲到。)

orange(adj./n.)橘色的、柳橙、橘子
(無詞性變化)
orange juice 柳橙汁
orange peel 橘子皮
I drink orange juice every morning.
(我每天早上都喝柳橙汁。)
She painted the wall orange.
(她把牆漆成橘色。)

order(n./v.)順序、命令、訂購、點餐
orderly(adj.)整齊的、有秩序的
in order to 為了
place an order 下訂單
Are you ready to order?
(您準備好點餐了嗎？)
Put the words in the right order.
(把這些字依正確順序排列。)

other(adj./pron.)其他的、另一個
otherwise(adv.)否則、不然
each other 彼此
the other day 前幾天
We help each other with homework.
(我們互相幫忙寫功課。)
Some students like math, and others like art.
(有些學生喜歡數學，其他人則喜歡美術。)

out(adv./prep./adj./n./v.)在外、出去、熄滅的、出局
outer(adj.)外面的
go out 外出
find out 查明、發現
Let's go out for dinner tonight.
(我們今晚出去吃晚餐吧。)
I need to find out the truth.
(我必須查明真相。)

outside(prep./adv./adj./n.)在外面、外面的、外部
outsider(n.)局外人
outside the door 在門外
go outside 到外面去
The children are playing outside.
(孩子們正在外面玩。)
It is cold outside today.
(今天外面很冷。)

over(prep./adv.)在……上方、超過、結束
(無詞性變化)
over there 在那裡
all over 到處
The game is over.
(比賽結束了。)
The plane flew over our house.
(飛機從我們家上空飛過。)

own(adj./pron./v.)自己的、擁有
owner(n.)擁有者、主人
ownership(n.)所有權
on your own 獨自、靠自己
own a house 擁有房子
I have my own room now.
(我現在有自己的房間了。)
Who owns this black car?
(這輛黑色的車是誰的？)
